$comment: Experiences (Duniya) and viewer environments (Mahaul). Validated against packages/contracts/schemas/experience.v1.json; seeded by services/api Flyway V11 (ExperiencesSeedTest fails if the two diverge); edited afterwards in the management portal (experiences) or read-only there (environments, until backdrop presets become uploadable data). An experience curates existing concepts (a backdrop, a default style, a motif pack, ordered Avatars, curated Shop items, seasons) and adds no geometry. Ids are snake_case English and never change; codename/title/tagline are brand copy and may, slugs are URLs (/duniya/<slug>). Environment labels and backdrop colours mirror tokens.json environments, whose keys are the storefront's preset keys; comic_rooftop_night waits for its preset (PR 12), so Katha stays unavailable until then. Accents come from the tokens.json brand colours; the cream paper stays (paper_tint null) and hero media arrives when shot.

experiences.title: Festive & gifting
experiences.tagline: Gifts that glow for every festival
experiences.description: For Diwali, Christmas, Rakhi and Valentine's: your photo, name or motif on a gift made for the occasion. A night light, an ornament, a nameplate, a keychain or a magnet, shown on a teak table by candlelight.

experiences.title: Desk & gaming
experiences.description: A keycap with your emblem, stands for your phone and headphones, a nameplate for the desk and a charm for your keys: pieces for the place where you work and play.

experiences.title: Memories & keepsakes
experiences.description: A photo that glows as a night light, a loved one's form on a plinth, a frame for the day it happened and a magnet for the fridge: keepsakes made from your memories.

experiences.title: Kids & party
experiences.description: Name charms for school bags, magnets for the fridge gallery, ornaments for the party room and, soon, a topper for the cake: bright, sturdy pieces with their name on.

experiences.title: Comics & heroes
experiences.description: Bring your own hero into a comic-book world: a keychain, a keycap with their emblem, a figurine on a plinth, a nameplate, a magnet or a night light. Original heroes only; the hero and the story are yours.
